title: Quick Assist Hover Panels for First-Run Onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of small, hover-triggered assist panels (micro-flyouts) and screenshot-ready assets that guide developers through first-run tasks in the Redwood Console. These panels should provide concise instructions, one-click links to docs, and optional quick actions (e.g., 'Create API key', 'View example prompt'). Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for new signups and lower initial support tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Hover panels appear on first-run routes (Model selection, API keys, Quickstart) and can be dismissed per-session
Each panel has a title, 1-2 line description, primary CTA, optional secondary CTA, and single-line tip
All panels available as responsive PNG/SVG assets for marketing and release notes (desktop, tablet, mobile widths)
Design tokens match Console theme and high-contrast mode; components meet WCAG AA color contrast
Localization-ready copy placeholders for en, fr, de, ja; assets exported with safe-area for translations
Developer handoff includes CSS spec, ARIA attributes, and annotated screenshots in Figma
screenshots_required: API keys quick action panel (desktop + mobile)
assets: SVG icon set (12 icons) - with 24/16px variants
Annotated redlines PDF for dev handoff
dev_notes: Prefer hover for desktop, focus/click for mobile — provide explicit dismiss and 'Don't show again' per-session control
Include aria-describedby linking from target element to panel; ensure keyboard dismiss with Esc
Provide a 'screenshot mode' variant: neutral bg and no transient cursor/tooltips for assets generation
Avoid heavy animations; use 150ms fade+translate to meet accessibility preferences
review_feedback: PM (Marisol Rivera): prefer stronger primary CTA copy for API key panel ('Create API key' -> 'Create API key now')
Engineering (Ethan Kim): request reduced max width to 420px for consistency with sidebar space; flagged potential layout overflow on long model names
Accessibility (Sofia Liu): confirm color token contrasts in high-contrast theme and provide focus-visible spec
Design critique (internal): propose adding a compact 'mini' variant for low-density screens — accepted pending prototype
notes: We intentionally avoid the term 'tour' to reduce friction; micro-flyouts emphasize immediate task completion
This set is intended to supplement (not replace) the existing in-panel documentation links and full help pages
Observed support metrics: onboarding-related tickets spiked 18% among accounts created last quarter — target a 30% reduction after rollout
next_steps: Resolve engineering layout constraint (ENG-2207) and update figma redlines - due 2026-03-16
Finalize copy localization keys and send CSV to localization team - due 2026-03-17
